summary: Consolidate zby with ṣby, preserving the z spelling as a variant.
before: zby (< MEA ṣby cf. SL 1271: to love, want, will;)
after: zby (< MEA ṣby cf. SL 1271: to love, want, will;)
rationale: The permitted lookup finds ṣby I ṣbele/ṣobe 'wollen', with the identical etymology 'MEA ṣby … SL 1271: to love, want, will'. zby I zbele/zobe has the same meaning and etymology. Crucially, zby's own supplied source 62/7 spells its quoted verb 'ṣbele', the form heading the ṣby entry. The entries give complementary Preterit and Infectum examples of this one verb; retain both sets of examples and the z variant when consolidating.
